purpose: taxids for 20 names by qualified label ("Name <qualifier>"), batch 3
sparql: PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/> SELECT ?t ?l WHERE { ?t rdfs:label ?l . FILTER(REGEX(STR(?t),'NCBITaxon_[0-9]+$')) FILTER(REGEX(STR(?l), "^(Lepidosauria|Testudines|Crocodylia|Mammalia|Theria|Eutheria|Glires|Rodentia|Myomorpha|Muridae|Murinae|Mus|Primates|Carnivora|Artiodactyla|Ecdysozoa|Arthropoda|Hexapoda|Insecta|Diptera) <[^>]*>$")) }
